data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2021 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $50.033m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a small net favourable prior-year development of approximately $2.12m (a c.4.2% release relative to opening gross claims), driven by favourable development on older underwriting years (2018 and 2019). The syndicate's calendar year result was nevertheless adversely impacted by a series of North American and other catastrophe events (including Hurricane Ida and the Texas Winter Storm) and by COVID-19 related development on the 2020 year, with the Property/Treaty portfolio bearing the exposures.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $42,766,000 is a deterioration of $427,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2020: deterioration of $5,407,000).
The 2019 year of account incurred significant losses from the natural catastrophe events that occurred in the calendar year, namely Hurricane Dorian, and Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai.
Our estimates for the 2020 COVID-19 related losses for the syndicate have increased over the 2021 calendar year following further information from clients regarding the losses.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2020). No explicit single-line 'movement in prior years provision' gross figure was provided; prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 36). The report also contains a sentence referencing a net deterioration of $0.427m in prior year reserves (this is a net figure within 'net calendar year claims incurred') which differs from the gross-triangle derived release of $2.119m. Amounts reported here are in the report's native currency (USD).
